Start with the introduction's account of the problem: models that read one word after another can't be trained in parallel [spya-ev2yj8]. Then read the novelty claim [spya-vr7tsj] and Section 4's case for the change [spya-eev6uu]. The author-contributions footnote is worth a look too, since it records who proposed what [spya-jf2h4q]. You can skim most of Section 3 and all of Section 5.

The Glossary will cover terms like "attention" and "BLEU".

You can skim the architecture details in Section 3 and the training and tables in Sections 5 and 6.
